paperhealth_plist:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  LaunchAgent: health-check the paper-trade daemon around the dispatch windows.

  Runs scripts/paper_healthcheck.py — verifies the daemon has a live PID, IB Gateway's API port is
  listening, and the equity snapshot isn't stale. On failure it posts a macOS notification and exits
  non-zero. Fires weekdays at three Pacific times chosen to catch problems before/after the daemon
  actually trades: 06:15 (before the 6:30 open), 12:50 (before the 1:00 close), 13:15 (after it).
  This keeps alerting to when it matters and avoids overnight false alarms from the Gateway
  auto-restart.

  Install:
    cp ops/com.traderjoe.paperhealth.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/
    launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.traderjoe.paperhealth.plist
  Run now:  launchctl start com.traderjoe.paperhealth
  Logs:     data/paper_health.log
  (For email/Slack instead of a desktop notification, swap `notify` in the script for a webhook.)
-->
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
    <key>Label</key>
    <string>com.traderjoe.paperhealth</string>

    <key>ProgramArguments</key>
    <array>
        <string>/Users/ryansharp/workspace/trader/.venv/bin/python3</string>
        <string>/Users/ryansharp/workspace/trader/scripts/paper_healthcheck.py</string>
    </array>

    <key>WorkingDirectory</key>
    <string>/Users/ryansharp/workspace/trader</string>

    <key>StartCalendarInterval</key>
    <array>
        <!-- 06:15 PT (pre-open), 12:50 PT (pre-close), 13:15 PT (post-close) — Mon–Fri -->
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>1</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>6</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>1</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>12</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>50</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>1</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>13</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>2</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>6</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>2</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>12</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>50</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>2</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>13</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>3</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>6</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>3</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>12</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>50</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>3</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>13</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>4</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>6</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>4</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>12</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>50</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>4</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>13</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>5</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>6</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>

        <dict><key>Weekday</key><integer>5</integer><key>Hour</key><integer>13</integer><key>Minute</key><integer>15</integer></dict>
    </array>

    <key>StandardOutPath</key>
    <string>/Users/ryansharp/workspace/trader/data/paper_health.log</string>
